Platform Overview

The Briggstone Orchestration Platform

A unified control plane for enterprise AI operations — from legacy data ingestion to governed multi-agent execution. Built for architects who need reliability, observability, and compliance at scale.

Bridge Control Plane

Configure, monitor, and scale data bridges between legacy systems and AI agent clusters from a single dashboard. Supports REST, SOAP, JDBC, and message queue connectors.

  • Auto-discovery of legacy endpoints
  • Schema mapping & transformation engine
  • Versioned API synthesis layer

Agent Fleet Manager

Deploy, scale, and govern autonomous agent swarms with role-based policies, approval chains, and inter-agent communication protocols.

  • Multi-model agent routing
  • Policy-as-code enforcement
  • Human-in-the-loop workflows

Context Vector Engine

Enterprise RAG with intelligent routing across knowledge silos. Hybrid search, re-ranking, and context window optimization built in.

  • Multi-tenant vector isolation
  • Semantic + keyword hybrid retrieval
  • Automatic context compression

Observability Suite

Full-stack telemetry with decision tracing, cost attribution, and compliance audit trails. Export to your existing SIEM and APM tools.

  • Real-time decision graph visualization
  • Token-level cost analytics
  • Immutable audit log export
